summary: A step sequencer for the FM TONE synth voice from ChoralRoot. For now it runs on a Mac with the FM-1 as its control panel; a native FM-1 firmware is planned as a second phase.
features: Eight tracks sharing 16 voices; pool of 128 sounds
Per-step overrides of track defaults, plus p-locks
Pages with their own start and end points
Conditions, chance, ratchets and chords of up to six notes
Currently needs a Mac: sound comes from the computer, not the FM-1
Browser preview with an on-screen FM-1
